description: Which repeated properties are refused and in what words (all live-measured): duplicate property 'X'; for table/view/sequence/warehouse/task properties (a sequence reports its INTERNAL name), conflicting values file format parameter 'X' / for copy option 'X', Multiple DEFAULT or AUTOINCREMENT expressions for a column's one slot, primary-key and constraint-signature sentences naming the TABLE, routine options refused as syntax errors - and what stays LEGAL: repeated CLUSTER BY, repeated COMMENT on stages/routines, NOT NULL twice or beside NULL, COLLATE twice, two UNIQUE columns, free option order, and a stage URL after another option. Converted 1:1 from ddl/DuplicatePropertyTest (now retired).
